Every i18n key + English default preserved: widget.costForecast.noData/nextMonth/trend/title/avgPerKwh/costLabel.

Recharts BarChart (web L145-178) -> native <CostForecastBarChart> (no DOM/SVG in RN): a fixed-height (isWide?150:130) frame with a left currency Y-axis (3 ticks `${currencySymbol}${fmt(v,0)}` at domainMax / domainMax/2 / 0, mirroring the web YAxis width={40} tickFormatter), a plot with 0/50/100% grid lines (web chartGrid) and one View bar per BarDatum (height = max((cost/domainMax)*100, 3)% when cost>0, fill BAR_COLOR='#6366f1' matching the web Bar fill, alignSelf center + maxWidth 32 mirroring maxBarSize={32}, top corner radius 4 mirroring radius={[4,4,0,0]}), and an X-axis row of per-month labels (web XAxis dataKey='month'). domainMax = Math.max(maxCost, 1) approximates Recharts' auto [0,max] domain. The web `fmt` helper (fmtNumber, 1dp default) is inlined.

Browser-only / unported deps reduced and documented inline: react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation t(key,fallback?) = (fallback ?? key) (none of this widget's keys interpolate); lucide TrendingUp/TrendingDown -> 📈/📉 glyphs tinted amber (colors.warning, trendUp) / emerald (colors.success, down) for the title and muted for the EmptyState glyph; @/components/charts (Recharts + chartGrid/chartMargin/axisTick/axisTickSm/chartAnimation/fmt) -> the native CostForecastBarChart above (the hover-only <Tooltip>, which has no native analogue, is dropped and replaced by an accessibilityLabel summary; chartAnimation entrance easing is not reproduced); useVehicles/useCostForecast -> already-ported web-parity hooks (request auto-prefixes /api/v1 so /analytics/cost-forecast is reached verbatim); useFormatting -> scoped native useFormatting() reading the same web-parity useSettings() query and exposing the consumed currencySymbol + formatCurrency(amount, decimals?) with byte-for-byte identical logic (currency_symbol trim fallback '$'; decimal_precision -> userPrecision floor, else 2); WidgetChartSummary + ChartSummaryStat -> native equivalents (stat grid + chart slot + EmptyState, ChartSummaryStat {label,value,unit?}); WidgetShell -> native shell reproducing the loading skeleton, error body, 1500ms pulse-on-update glow and the inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph + relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less); ./types WidgetProps -> local WidgetSize{cols,rows}+WidgetProps; @/types/charging CostHistoricalMonth/CostForecastMonth -> the identical interfaces re-exported by the native useCharging hook.

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/span/h3 -> View/AppText; ResponsiveContainer width/height 100% -> fixed-height native frame; flex h-full flex-col -> View column; the stat grid (grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 / @sm flex) -> flexDirection row + flexWrap + statCell flexBasis 45%; CSS vars text-[var(--text-primary|muted)] -> colors.textPrimary/textMuted; text-amber-400 / text-emerald-400 title intent -> colors.warning / colors.success; em-dash kept as '\u2014'; ↑/↓ kept as '\u2191'/'\u2193'. The Tooltip contentStyle/cursor and chartMargin/chartAnimation were Recharts-only presentation and have no native equivalent (documented above). State names (chartData/nextForecast/nextCost/hist/lastHistorical/lastCost/trendUp/isCompact/isWide/hasData), the API path (/analytics/cost-forecast via useCostForecast), unit handling (currency via useFormatting), and i18n intent are all preserved.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported. Imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View/DimensionValue), the already-ported web-parity useCostForecast/useVehicles/useSettings hooks (+ Cost*Month types), the native AppText, and the theme tokens (colors/spacing). StyleSheet keys + properties are alphabetically sorted for react-native/sort-styles. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
